# Todoist

Todoist is a task management tool allowing users to create to-do lists, set deadlines, and collaborate on projects with reminders and cross-platform syncing

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/todoist/.

## Actions

- **Add Workspace**: Create a new workspace in todoist.
- **Close Task**: This tool marks an existing task as completed in todoist.
- **Create Comment**: Create a new comment in todoist.
- **Create Label**: Creates a new label.
- **Create Project**: Creates a new project in todoist.
- **Create Section**: Create a new section within a specific project.
- **Create task**: Create a new task in todoist.
- **Delete Label**: Delete a specific label.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a specific todoist project.
- **Delete Section**: Delete a specific section.
- **Delete task**: Delete a task from todoist.
- **Get All Comments** (read-only): This tool retrieves all comments associated with a specific task or project in todoist.
- **Get all labels** (read-only): Get all personal labels from todoist.
- **Get all projects** (read-only): Get all projects from a user's todoist account.
- **Get All Sections** (read-only): Retrieve all sections for a specific project in todoist.
- **Get All Tasks** (read-only): Fetches all tasks from todoist and returns their details.
- **Get Backups** (read-only): List all available backup archives for the user.
- **Get Comment** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific comment by its comment id.
- **Get Label** (read-only): Retrieve a specific label by its id.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Retrieve a specific project by its id.
- **Get Section** (read-only): Retrieve a specific section by its id.
- **Get Special Backups** (read-only): List special backup archives for the user.
- **Get Task** (read-only): Retrieve a specific task by its id.
- **List Archived Workspace Projects** (read-only): List all archived projects in a workspace.
- **List Filters** (read-only): List all filters for the authenticated user.
- **Reopen Task**: This tool reopens a previously completed task.
- **Update Project**: Update a specific project's attributes such as name, color, indent, and order.
- **Update Task**: Update an existing task's properties.
- **List Pending Workspace Invitations** (read-only): List pending invitation emails in a workspace.
- **Update Comment**: Update a specific comment's content.
- **Update Section**: Update a specific section's attributes such as name and order.
